target.name: signed_loader_kernel_abi
target.detail: struct bpf_map.sha is missing; boot a shirudo-patched kernel

target.name: kernel_lsm_hooks
target.detail: kernel has no LSM hooks bdev_free_security, bdev_setintegrity, bpf_prog_load, inode_file_setattr, inode_post_removexattr, mm_read_access, tpm_command (7 of 49); boot a shirudo-patched kernel
target.hint: mm_read_access, tpm_command come only from patches shirudo carries; no stock kernel has them

target.name: bpf_lsm_active
target.hint: needs CONFIG_BPF_LSM=y and bpf in CONFIG_LSM, or lsm=lockdown,capability,landlock,yama,apparmor,bpf on the kernel command line

target.name: kernel_config
target.detail: 1 required option(s) missing; CONFIG_LSM="landlock,lockdown,yama,integrity,apparmor", so bpf must be added with lsm= (/boot/config-6.8.0-149-generic)
items: CONFIG_CRYPTO_MLDSA (ML-DSA-87, the only signature shirudo makes)

target.name: tpm2_device
target.hint: shirudo opens it as root; this check only sees that it exists

target.name: systemd_version
target.hint: needs systemd 256 or newer (shirudo-initrd.service orders after tpm2.target)

target.name: uki_boot
target.detail: UEFI boot, but no systemd-stub variables (not a unified kernel image)
target.hint: a target boots a signed UKI through systemd-stub, which measures the initrd into PCR 11

target.name: dracut_initrd
target.hint: a target boots a systemd initrd built by dracut with shirudo's 90shirudo module

target.name: keyring_cmdline
target.hint: a target boots with both, from its signed UKI, so that init can enroll and seal the keyrings
